title: Market Validation & Rubric Construction
goal: Verify SME technical hiring pain points firsthand and standardize practical screening frameworks.

tasks.text: Conduct 20 structured interviews with Coimbatore SME plant managers & HR heads (Kurichi, SIDCO, Peelamedu)
Audit 5 local competitor pricing proposals and contract terms for technical operator roles
Draft HireReady CNC/VMC, Quality, and Maintenance 20-point practical assessment rubrics
Secure access to a partner machine shop or ITI training center for in-person practical tests
Prototype digital 'Candidate Passport' template with verified verification badges
Incorporate Sole Proprietorship / LLP, obtain MSME Udyam and GST certificates

title: Lean Pilot Launch & First Placements
goal: Acquire early adopter manufacturing clients and execute end-to-end verified placements.

tasks.text: Sign contingency recruitment agreements with 4–6 Coimbatore engineering SMEs (at 8.33% CTC)
Source 80+ technician resumes via regional portals, WhatsApp trade groups, and ITI alumni networks
Screen candidates through phone interview + practical workshop test, certifying 25 'HireReady' profiles
Deliver 3-candidate verified shortlists to employers within 72 hours of receiving mandate
Coordinate employer interviews, track attendance, and facilitate offer rollout
Achieve first 3-5 confirmed candidate joinings with replacement guarantee terms

title: Measurement, Unit Economics & Scaling
goal: Evaluate operational velocity, client satisfaction, replacement rate, and financial runway.

tasks.text: Analyze conversion funnel: Shortlist-to-Interview, Interview-to-Offer, Offer-to-Join ratios
Audit candidate 30-day and 60-day retention rates at client machine shops
Collect Net Promoter Score (NPS) and structured feedback from both plant heads and placed candidates
Test premium pricing tier (10% CTC for urgent CNC programmer/supervisor roles)
Calculate Net Cash Flow vs ₹5 Lakh budget and project month 4–12 runway
Make Go / No-Go decision on expanding into Tirupur / Erode or hiring a full-time recruiter
